rationale_bullets: Drew Mestemaker (88.3/536) arrives as the national passing champ - 4,379 at 68.7%, 34-9, #4 QB Rating, 1st-team AAC, #3 transfer QB of the cycle - with 'first NFL-caliber quarterback since Mason Rudolph' framing (P6).
The continuity is the multiplier: HC Morris + OC Brophy ran the exact offense at North Texas; all three books lead with it ('probably the most improved QB position in the country' - PS).
Grant Jordan (64.8/130; Yale/UMass starts) is a real backup.
62 = above average: elite G5 production in-scheme, discounted for the level jump (Weigman's 62 at Houston is the deliberate comparable: P4 tape + injury history vs elite-G5 + continuity).
data_gaps: One full year as a starter
grades_detail.g5_guard_note: 88.3/4,379 earned vs AAC; graded above-average P4, not elite, pending P4 tape - scheme continuity is the offset that holds it at 62

rationale_bullets: Caleb Hawkins (92.6; 231 att/1,431 at 6.2) led the AAC in rushing and the FBS in rushing TDs (25; Athlon: freshman-record 29 total) and made PS 3rd-team All-America - now in the same scheme.

The depth is verified volume, not projection: Adeyi (68.5; 1,017 at 7.1 for NT in '23), Page III (Tarleton-leading 839 at 7.5 as a FR), Mason (735 D2), KD Jones (PS#29 FR); PS: 'quality situational depth behind Hawkins.'
All '25 backs are gone (combined 1,172 at 4.4 - 8th-pctile as-played), which loses nothing of value.
60 = above average with the G5 discount; the proxy's 97 is what the tape says if you ignore the level.
grades_detail.g5_guard_note: 92.6/1,434 earned vs AAC; graded 60 not 70+ - in-scheme transplant + verified depth keep it above average

rationale_bullets: Wyatt Young (89.0; 70-1,264 at 18.1, 1st-team AAC) arrives as Mestemaker's favorite target, in-scheme; Coleman (81.1; 928 over two NT years) follows.
The P4 tape is the differentiator vs a pure G5 haul: Barnes (76.9; 547 at 14.0 + 143 rush at Wake Forest, 4* transfer) and 6'5 Bowick (70.4; Morris: 'NFL caliber').
Volume behind them: Polk (62.9; 525 at Akron), Harris II (62.5; 419 at Ohio), Lewis (NT); TE Green (LSU; PS TE#4) won the spring job but his tape is blocking-first (2 rec).
55 = average-plus: deep, multi-sourced, real P4 pieces - topline still G5-graded.
grades_detail.g5_guard_note: Young 89.0 + Coleman 81.1 vs AAC; Barnes/Bowick P4 tape is why this sits 55 rather than dropping to average

rationale_bullets: An all-transfer starting five from a nine-transfer pool (117 incoming career starts): Nelson (71.6/961, All-AAC), Dickson III (71.9/818, 2nd-team AAC), Hanson (71.9/572, 4th-team SBC), Sexton (60.6; 14 starts across four years at OU), Lepo (55.2/189 MSU), Mercer (66.5/44 KU) - PS and Athlon print different arrangements (battle unsettled).
Seven '25 linemen gone (54 starts), six to P4 rosters - but that line was 14th-pctile in run blocking anyway (75th pass-block, 22 sacks).
Three 70+ PFF linemen and NT scheme familiarity (Dickson/Nelson/Mercer/Magiya) vs chemistry-from-scratch and thin P4 tape; Morris 'confident in his top 7 or 8' (PS).
44 = fringe-below-average: real pieces, unproven at this level, zero continuity.
grades_detail.g5_guard_note: Nelson/Dickson All-AAC grades earned vs G5 fronts; guard keeps the unit below average despite three 70+ tapes

rationale_bullets: Seven linemen gone (30 st/117 tkl/9 sk) including the best player: Gregory (71.4/419, B12 Def Newcomer of the Year) -> Kansas State; Duhon (70.1/230) -> Tulsa, Nnodim -> Penn State.
Retained partials are real: Jaleel Johnson (78.2/150 - best returning tape on the defense, injury-shortened) and Malik Charles (67.5/279; 4 st, 28 tkl, 3 sk).

Ten transfers arrive as a deep 62-73 rotation with no premium anchor: Huddleston (70.4/409 NT), Clements (66.4/368 NG), Williams (69.9/249 FSU 'pass rush specialist'), Lawson (68.8/226), Rigsby (73.2/133), White (71.6/60, ex-PSU 4*), DJ Jackson (62.2/350).
'25 was RDEF 50th / PRSH 16th pctile; PS: 'better shape on the outside… still needs reliable interior run-stuffers.' 45 = fringe-below-average.
Ethan Wesloski (90.6/804; 9 st, 113 tkl, 9 TFL, 2nd-team AAC) followed DC Cassity - the single best defensive tape in the incoming class, in-scheme.

Isaiah Chisom (66.6/546; 84 tkl at UCLA) brings real P4 volume; Trip White RETURNS (69.5/294; PS loosely filed the ex-Ole Miss returner among adds - PFF/roster confirm '25 snaps here); Puckett (DII All-American) and Winner-Johnson (Tulane) behind. 'Top 4 LBs are set' (PS).
Romney (49.6/101 at ASU; 13 tkl in 10 gm) is the tape-vs-framing weak link among projected starters.
GONE: McCoy (60.6/666, #2 tackler) graduated; Esonwune, Utu, Oliphant portal. 52 = average-plus.
grades_detail.g5_guard_note: Wesloski's 90.6 earned vs AAC; guard caps the unit at average-plus rather than the proxy's 81

rationale_bullets: LaDainian Fields (77.2/255; 12 starts as a true sophomore) is the defense's lone returning starter and a quality young piece; Cameron Epps withdrew from the portal (override: Athlon May two-deep + PS lineup + P6 'back from injury') adding 51 tkl/3 INT of L3Y experience.
The '25 unit was 8th-pctile COV (#132 PDR, 65.6%, 28-6) and three starters left - the reload can't lose much.

Eight arrivals with real tape: Bodnar (71.8/581 Liberty; 'huge spring praise from Morris'), Lewis (75.9/437; NT's top corner), Jackson (69.9/458; 130 tkl L3Y), Hammonds (64.0/582), Phillips (77.3/149 Mizzou), Horn (14 st/30 gm L3Y at TTech; no '25 tape).
48 = fringe-average: volume + youth upside, one proven P4 starter total; NT was #37 PDR under this staff.

Both legs are new but tape-real: K Keltner (SMU: 13 st, 14-of-20, long 51, 42 TB - 'asked to increase his consistency' per Athlon) and P Pozzobon (SFA: FCS Freshman All-American, 41.8 avg/40.5 net, 17 inside-20).
Barnes is the return-game upgrade ('highlight-reel plays at Wake Forest'); LS Yates follows from NT.
The departed unit was 7th-pctile SPEC and P Pahl (46.5) was its one strength; PS: 'wont drop much with better depth.'
45 = fringe-below-average: proven-ish legs, no elite piece, whole operation new.
